query:
SELECT
            ds.uuid AS "data_source_uuid!: DataSourceUuid",
            ds.name AS data_source_name,
            fm.rel_path
        FROM unidentified_videos uv
        JOIN file_measurements fm
            ON fm.id = uv.file_id
        JOIN data_sources ds
            ON ds.id = fm.data_source_id
        WHERE uv.interpretation_id = ?
